FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 476
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Marilyn Lands
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/14/2025
House Bill 476 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Attorney
General to review evidence regarding exemptions of certain provisions of this bill.
This bill would also provide for the imposition of civil fines, not exceeding $10,000 per
violation of the provisions of this bill.
